signature: RepDist_C : TYPE_PROJECTION_C x TYPE_PROJECTION_C x TYPE_WITNESS_C -> Prop
formation_rules: p and q must have type TYPE_PROJECTION_C
semantic_truth_conditions: RepDist_C(p, q, w) iff type(p) = TYPE_PROJECTION_C and type(q) = TYPE_PROJECTION_C and TypedWitness_C(w) and Relation_C(p, q, w) and TraceCompatible_C(w)
required_premises: TraceCompatible_C(w) where TraceCompatible_C is explicitly indexed by context C
failure_conditions: p or q has wrong type (D-D-WITNESS-WRONG-TYPE-001)
open_questions: Is Relation_C context-free or must it be explicitly context-indexed for all C?
